findings.description: The new `params` argument of `Session.get` is accepted but never forwarded; the call passes only `**kwargs` to `self.request`, so `params` is silently discarded.
findings.rationale: Trigger: calling `session.get(url, params={'q': 'x'})`. The `params` value is bound to the local parameter and not included in `kwargs`, so `self.request("GET", url, **kwargs)` runs without it. Impact: the request goes to the server without the query string, returning wrong results with no error raised.
